Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring state agencies to allow volunteer fire fighters to respond when called to duty.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring state agencies to allow volunteerfirefighters to respond when called to duty; and adding a new sectionto chapter 41.06 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An agency must allow an employee who is a volunteer firefighter torespond, without pay, to a fire or natural disaster when called toduty. The agency may choose to grant leave with pay.
